summary: Signed plate-reader qualification certificate from October 2008, with the control response checks, the qualification status and a next review date. Scanned copy with a received stamp and a handwritten note from the signer.

blocks.p: This certificate records the routine qualification of the plate reader used for the primary potency and kinetic solubility work. It covers the optical checks and the control response checks made on the qualification day.
Both control plates were read in the standard layout. The positive and negative control responses were compared against the acceptance record for the instrument.

The plate reader is qualified for use on the primary potency and solubility assays from the date of this certificate. Plates read before qualification on the previous check are covered by the earlier certificate.

list.text: Not qualified for the medium-throughput layout until the next check

blocks.p: The next routine qualification is due at the start of the new year. Any repair or lamp change before then requires a new qualification before plates are read.
